patterns.note: Initial hero section uses extreme negative space with centered, sparse text, transitioning to a full-width, richly illustrated brand identity section upon scroll.
The brand name 'IRONHILL' is rendered in an exceptionally large, decorative serif font, dominating the lower half of the initial viewport and serving as a key visual element upon scroll.
A high-contrast two-tone palette of light cream and deep forest green defines the primary sections, with subtle gold accents in illustrations.

As the user scrolls, the initial light-colored content section slides upwards with a diagonal bottom edge, revealing a large, dark green brand identity section that appears to be fixed or parallaxing slowly in the background.
The page transitions from an ethereal, text-heavy introduction to a bold, illustrative brand reveal, followed by a functional footer with navigation and signup.

technique_notes: The site employs a scroll-triggered reveal where a foreground content block with a diagonal bottom edge scrolls over a large, fixed or slow-parallaxing background element. This creates a dramatic transition from an airy, text-focused hero to a dense, illustrative brand statement. The large brand name and its associated illustrations are part of this background element, appearing to 'uncover' as the user scrolls down.
The hero text is presented with generous line spacing and letter spacing, creating an elegant, almost poetic feel, contrasting with the bold, illustrative brand section.

design_tokens.type_scale: extremely oversized, decorative display font for the brand name (~8x body) with elegant, well-spaced serif body text (~1x body).
design_tokens.radius: sharp corners throughout, with no visible rounded elements.
design_tokens.spacing: very airy in the initial hero section, transitioning to a balanced density in the footer and brand identity section.

standout: The site's standout feature is its dramatic, large-scale typography for the brand name, integrated with intricate, mythical illustrations, which are revealed through a distinctive diagonal parallax scroll. This creates a unique blend of elegance and whimsical storytelling, making the brand feel established and intriguing.
